mode: Opus 5.5 development revision of the 09-16 candidate_04 plan. Developer has seen all prior candidates and the user's rejection; not a cold start and not a working-model result.

interior_scheme.summary: Double-loaded office floors: one continuous L-shaped corridor linking two circulation clusters at the ends of the L. South cluster = main stair hall behind the street glazing composition above the south-west entrance bay, WC/service rooms behind the street band that has only narrow top-storey windows, and a lift/service core on the courtyard side under the southern roof head. North cluster = stair+lift core in the inner corner under the northern roof head, with an interior WC/service room. Office bands (merged cellular offices) on both sides of the corridor; a corner room at the two nonstandard north-west window columns. Ground floor = main office entrance hall at the south-west bay, street retail, north lobby from the (unscanned) north street front, back-of-house; courtyard annex kept as one commercial hall.
principles: Every partition that meets an exterior wall lands in an observed window pier; window hosting fails otherwise, and no observed window was moved or clipped.
Two separated vertical circulation clusters at the two ends of the L give every office band two escape directions; the corridor is the minimum circulation connecting them.
Cores sit where both facades are windowless and where the raised roof masses (lift machine / stair heads) stand, not at arbitrary positions.
Office bands are declared groups of cellular offices merged at this moderate detail level; they are not claimed to be open plan and are not split by orientation or per window.
Continuous vertical spaces have no intermediate slabs; where a stair continues into a storey space the horizontal contact is declared open on both sides.

grid_m.long_corridor_basis: Centred in the 14.5 m long-wing depth (6.05 m office bands each side). The attic storey (-11.6..-0.1) still contains it. Interior column lines unknown.
grid_m.short_corridor_basis: North edge 19.2 lies in both the street pier 18.70..19.46 (F2-F7) and the attic west-face pier 19.01..19.57 (F8). Leaves 7.0 m north and 8.0 m courtyard-side bands in the 17.4 m deep short wing.
grid_m.south_stair_basis: Street glazing composition y -32.34..-26.09 on F2-F7: the inventoried tall bay (two horizontal bands per storey, half-landing signature) plus the newly measured adjacent glazed column; directly above the dark south-west ground bay with a bright sign (entrance reading). North edge -25.5 lies in the wall between that column and the narrow top-storey window column (-25.08..-24.21).
grid_m.north_core_basis: Inner corner: set-back courtyard segment x 0.8..4.6 with one narrow window per storey and blank wall; northern raised roof mass x -3.5..6.5, y 10..16.5 stands over it. Continuous 0-27.8 m as in candidate_04, now enlarged to hold stair and lifts.
grid_m.north_service_basis: Windowless interior pocket between the long-wing courtyard band (ends at y 9.5) and the north core.
grid_m.corner_room_basis: Pier -3.59..-2.87 on the north facade; the room holds the two nonstandard large north window columns plus one standard column and two street columns.
grid_m.court_short_scan_hole_basis: court_short pixel buffer: first hits behind the facade (y≈26) for x>15.3 at every storey height; facade trace in all sections ends at x≈15.3.
grid_m.south_wc_basis: Street facade between the stair glazing and the first office window (-21.14) has only the narrow top-storey windows; small-window/windowless reading = WC/service.
grid_m.south_lift_core_basis: Courtyard facade has no inventoried window from -28.98 to -17.85; a partially scanned multi-pane glazed column (≈-27.8..-26.1, holes on some storeys) and the scan hole of a cropped projecting volume (-25.9..-21.8) follow. South edge -28.3 lies in the observed white pier -28.9..-28.0 so the glazed column stays inside the core wall. Under the southern raised roof mass (y -28.5..-20.8).

continuous_spaces.evidence: Main stair hall behind the street glazing composition (inventoried tall bay y -32.34..-27.97 with two bands per storey, plus the measured adjacent glazed column y -27.90..-26.09). Starts above the F1 entrance hall (open contact) and ends under the set-back F8 landing (open contact); flights/landings not modelled; may also hold a lift. Inferred from facade texture, not observed inside.

Lift/service core in the windowless courtyard-side band under the southern raised roof mass (lift machine-room reading), behind a partially scanned glazed column and the scan hole of a cropped projecting volume. Continues into the set-back F8 landing through an open contact. Lift count, shafts and any secondary stair are not modelled.

Stair and lift core in the inner corner under the northern raised roof mass; hosts the observed narrow corner windows on the set-back courtyard segment. Stair/lift detail and landing doors are inferred.

F1.evidence: Main office entrance hall at the dark south-west street bay (bright sign above) and lift lobby leading to the south lift core; the main stair rises from here (open contact with STAIR_S above). Entrance position is an inference from texture, not an observed door.
Ground-floor service/storage at the courtyard side of the south end, reached from the entrance hall. Use unknown.

Street retail behind the observed continuous shopfront groups GW01-GW12 and the observed glass shop door D_entry_west. Tenancy subdivision unknown and merged; a known large commercial ground floor is kept rather than cut per shop window.
Windowless interior pocket beside the north core; ground-floor WC/service reading.
North entrance lobby from the north street front to the north core. The ground-floor north facade is absent from the scan; the entrance is an inferred completion, not an observation.
Ground floor of the short wing facing the north street; commercial use from the public record of street-level commerce. Frontage openings are inferred (scan missing).

zones.evidence: Continuous L-shaped corridor linking the south stair hall, south lift core, north core and every office band. Width 2.4 m assumed.
South-east end office room(s) with the two observed courtyard windows per storey.
WC/service rooms behind the street band that has only the narrow top-storey windows (F6-F7) between the stair glazing and the office band.
Street-side office band: cellular offices along the corridor, individual partitions (at window piers, 3.1 m module) merged at this detail level. Not an open-plan claim.
Courtyard-side office band of the long wing; cellular offices merged at this detail level. The courtyard dark slot y -20.9..-19.1 stays unclassified.
Windowless interior pocket beside the north core; WC/service reading.
North-west corner room holding the two nonstandard large north window columns (F2-F7); larger meeting/management room reading. Could also be further subdivided.
North-street office band of the short wing; cellular offices merged at this detail level.
Courtyard-side office band of the short wing (8.0 m deep; may contain an internal storage strip). Cellular offices merged.
Top landing of the main stair inside the set-back attic outline; open contact to STAIR_S below.
Top lift/stair landing of the south core inside the set-back attic outline; open contact to CORE_S below.

annex.evidence: Observed low courtyard mass with two window rows; one tall commercial hall (no inferred mezzanine). M-roundel signage on its courtyard glazing and on the street shopfront suggests a shared commercial/public use, not asserted. Internal subdivision unknown.

connections.note: One representative door per declared pair, 0.95 m x 2.1 m at the middle of the longest shared edge. Pairs whose space does not exist on a storey are skipped (e.g. STAIR_S on F8, landings on F2-F7).

inferred_exterior_doors.basis: Inferred main office entrance inside the unclassified south-west ground bay y -33.16..-29.49 (dark recess, bright sign above; 09-16 opening_actions kept it unbuilt). Centred 1.8 m double door; actual leaf/threshold unknown.
Inferred shop entrance in north ground bay B01 (north ground facade absent from scan).
Inferred north office entrance in bay B03 leading to the north core (north ground facade absent from scan).
Inferred shop entrance in north ground bay B04 (north ground facade absent from scan).

inferred_windows.basis: North ground floor (z<6.5 m) is absent from the single-building scan (north.npz first hits land on the annex or the back wall). The north facade is a street front: same dark cladding as the west street facade, unlike the white courtyard render; public record states street-level commerce. Shopfront bays reuse the observed west ground rhythm (3.65 m glazing, 4.31 m pitch, z 0.35-5.20) mirrored from the north-west corner; bays B01/B03/B04 carry the inferred doors instead. Positions are completion hypotheses, not observations.

open_horizontal_contacts.reason: Main stair rises from the entrance hall; no slab at the stair foot.
Main stair continues to the set-back top landing.
South lift/stair core continues to the set-back top landing.

unknown_wall_regions.reason: Courtyard face of the south core: a multi-pane glazed column (≈-27.8..-26.1) is visible only on some storeys (others are scan holes), followed by the scan hole of a cropped projecting volume (first hits on the back of the street wall for y -25.9..-21.8 at all heights; section kinks towards x≈2.3 at y≈-21.8). Openings not inventoried; contact condition unknown, not a free blank facade and not an open passage.
Same courtyard scan hole continues at attic height (25.53 m section gap).
Courtyard ground facade east of the annex is absent from the scan.
court_short facade is absent from the scan for x>15.3 at every storey; possibly occluded by an adjoining courtyard wing. Window continuation not inferred.

unknown_attic_ends.reason: Set-back attic end walls stand above the neighbouring roofs; scan evidence insufficient to decide openings (unchanged from candidate_04).

party_walls.representation: physical source wall without openings; recorded in provenance.party_wall_inference because the enclosure schema has no adjacent-building condition
party_walls.reason: Both short ends are systematically missing from the scan up to ~22-26 m while every street/courtyard face is captured; the south end shows an adjoining roof silhouette (missing region peaks ≈26.5 m mid-width, ≈22-23.5 m at the edges) and a blank light upper strip, the east end shows only a dark blank strip above ≈25 m. Reading: fire/party walls against neighbouring buildings of a perimeter block, windowless. This replaces the 09-16 'unknown' for these walls; attic ends stay unknown.

assumptions: Opus 5.5 开发修订：在09-16冻结外壳/楼层/开口之上重做内部组织与缺失补全；已看过旧候选及用户退回意见，不是冷启动或工作模型成绩。
楼层标高、外壳、屋盖五部件、原287组窗坐标全部沿用candidate_04；所有新隔墙在碰到外墙处都落在已观测窗间墙内，未移动或裁剪任何窗。
本轮新量测并加入8组此前未入清单的沿街窗（楼梯间旁玻璃列F2-F7、卫生间窄窗F6-F7），方法与阈值见observations/west_band_windows.json；其余新增开口均标为补全推断。
标准层按双面走廊办公推断：长翼14.5 m进深取居中2.4 m走廊，短翼17.4 m进深在北侧7.0 m/内院侧8.0 m之间设走廊；走廊连通南北两端交通组。实际柱网、走廊位置和宽度未被观测。
南端交通组：沿街玻璃组合（旧清单高玻璃竖带，每层两道横带像楼梯平台；以及本轮新量出的相邻玻璃列）判为主楼梯间，其正下方首层西南暗色门洞＋亮色招牌判为主入口；其北侧只有顶两层窄窗的沿街带判为卫生间/服务；内院侧南屋顶凸起下方判为电梯/服务核，外侧是部分可见的多格玻璃列和被裁内院凸出体的扫描洞。均为纹理推断。
北端交通组：内院转角退后段（每层单窄窗）及北屋顶凸起下方为楼梯+电梯核，与旁边无窗的内部服务间一起；首层北面扫描缺失，按街面推断北入口门厅。
办公带是同侧连续单间办公室在本档的合并表达，不是开放办公声明；单间隔墙可按3.1 m窗间墙模数继续细分。西北角两列非标准大窗所在房间单列为角部会议/大办公室。
首层：观测到的沿街店面与玻璃店门归零售大厅，租户划分未知并合并；主入口门厅、后勤、北门厅按推断；北面首层店面窗与三处门为补全推断，非观测。附属低体仍为一个商业大厅，与零售大厅之间假设一门。
两短端（南y=-33.4、东x=19.5）F1-F7按扫描系统性缺失与相邻屋面剪影判为无窗贴邻山墙（实体墙），不再标未知；退台两端、内院被裁凸出体接触面、短翼内院东端扫描洞及首层内院缺面保留未知。
连续竖向空间无中间楼板；主楼梯从入口厅升起、在退台层落到平台，南核同样通到退台平台，这三处水平接触显式双侧敞开。
所有门均为每对空间一扇代表性连接，尺寸与位置为方案假设。
unresolved: 真实内部隔墙、单间划分、柱网、走廊宽度与门位没有任何内部资料；本方案只保证与外部观测约束相容。
西南沿街高玻璃竖带也可解释为大窗房间，主入口也可能在别处；若用户否定楼梯判断，可把STAIR_S改回办公端间，其余布局不变。
南核内电梯数量、次楼梯、烟囱/通风竖井（屋顶烟囱在走廊线附近）未建模；内院侧南端多格玻璃列（≈-27.8..-26.1）只部分扫到，未入窗清单，所在墙段保留未知。
内院被裁凸出体（y≈-26..-21.8）的真实深度与用途未知，未补体量；短翼内院东端（x>15.3）扫描洞未补窗。
北面首层店面/入口及西南主入口为补全推断；首层内院面、退台两端开口、屋盖曲面及残缺窗下沿仍未知。
贴邻山墙在源BIM中只能表示为无窗实体墙；邻楼贴邻条件需要公共围护词汇（见PUBLIC_INTERFACE_NOTES.md）。
